name: Ergast F1
tagline: Classic Formula 1 historical race results and standings API
description: Ergast provides historical Formula 1 data including race results, qualifying, drivers, constructors, circuits, and championship standings via a free public HTTP API. The classic ergast.com service has been widely used by developers; current host and operational status should be verified against official docs.

auth.details: No authentication required for public API access

use_cases: get Formula 1 race results for a season or round
fetch driver or constructor championship standings
list F1 circuits, drivers, or constructors by season
get qualifying results for a specific Grand Prix
look up lap times or pit stops for a race
